title: Asked days later about a scene they sent: answered from the document itself
origin: Issue #163 (More ways to send proof): Should, a question about an earlier file is answered from the file itself, never guessed

answers.what: short scenes for my novel, Lighthouse

document.name: lighthouse-scene-2.docx
document.text: The storm came in sideways. Mara bolted the shutters and counted the lamps: six, then five. Outside, a boat she didn't know was trying to make the harbor. She lit the seventh lamp herself and stood in the doorway with it, though no one could have seen it from the water. In the morning the boat was tied up at the far pier and nobody would say whose it was.

history.text: Scene 2 in! That seventh lamp is the whole scene for me. What made you end on nobody saying whose boat it was?
wanted it to stay a mystery

whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: a question about a document from days ago.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH answers from the scene itself: the first line ("The storm came in sideways") and what it does, specifically, then one thought or question about the rewrite. It never invents lines or details that aren't in the scene, and never answers vaguely as if it can't recall it.
